description: This source file implements time formatting and parsing functions for the Abseil C++ library, including handling of special infinite time values, formatting according to RFC3339 and RFC1123 standards, and conversions between time representations.

methods.name: FormatTime
methods.description: Formats an absl::Time object into a string according to a specified format and timezone.

methods.name: ParseTime
methods.description: Parses a string into an absl::Time object based on a specified format and timezone.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins seconds and femtoseconds into an absl::Time object.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits an absl::Time object into seconds and femtoseconds.
